profile_text.body:
Aurora Innovation, Inc. describes itself as a self-driving freight company whose work is powered by the Aurora Driver, a system it says combines hardware and software backed by verifiable AI and integrates autonomy into a customer's fleet. The company's site carries the tagline "Self-driving. Game-changing." and states its aim as delivering the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. Customer quotes on the site describe a pilot program autonomously hauling freight between Fort Worth and El Paso, a hybrid model using Werner professional drivers alongside the Aurora Driver, and a partnership with Volvo in which the Aurora Driver is integrated into the Volvo VNL Autonomous.

The company is a public company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, trading under the ticker AUR, with CIK 0001828108. No products are tracked for it, no MCP servers are listed, and no lawsuits are named. Its recorded legal exposure is in Pennsylvania, with a count of 174.
